title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
SEC 'Crypto Mom' Hester Peirce exits Oct 2 — agency drops to 2 commissioners; Crypto Task Force lead vacant (successor timeline 6–12 months).
BTC +0.69% at $84,602, holding Q3 close range. Q3 gain ~44%.
Data week: PCE (Aug) Wed Sep 30 + NFP Fri Oct 2 — final inputs before Oct FOMC (hike ~66% priced at 5.17% 10Y).
